2317-3967-7084-8345.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3301-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3301-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3301-3469-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

3755-4770-6090-7175.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6006-7060.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-2023-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1580-2060-6495-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-6495-6701.notes:
This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1778-2626-4986-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Memnite.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2267-3240-6462-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

5256-7084-7422.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1169-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3621-5226-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.
3621-5226-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

3259-7175-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

457-1329-3338-6747-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1510-4574-4659-5849.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2692-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

6995-7009-7012.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6995-7009-7012.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-5901.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-549-4853-5231.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

767-4222-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a charge counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.
767-4222-6702--119.notes: This combo will also give you infinite results from whatever method you use to tap Kilo.

1283-2440-5256-5544.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Skeleton and/or Rogue you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4613-4968-5902-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1231-2921-4826-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4153-6577-6622--114.description:
Cast Replenish by paying {3}{W}, returning Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and the read-ahead Saga from your graveyard to the battlefield. Choose to have the read-ahead Saga enter with enough lore counters on it to trigger its final chapter ability.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's first chapter ability and each chapter ability from the read-ahead Saga trigger.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda trigger, exiling Replenish from your graveyard.
Resolve each trigger from the read-ahead Saga, and put it into your graveyard when you resolve its final chapter ability.
Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a number of lore counters on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda equal to the number of lore counters that were on the read-ahead Saga, triggering Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's second, third and fourth chapter abilities.
Resolve the second and third chapter triggers, adding {R}{R} for each lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda.
Resolve the fourth chapter trigger, adding {R} for each lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and causing you to pay {4} to cast Replenish from exile, returning Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and the read-ahead Saga from your graveyard to the battlefield. Choose to have the read-ahead Saga enter with enough lore counters on it to trigger its final chapter ability.
Repeat from step 2.

325-5014-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-5014-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-5014-5796-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

4231-4979-5856-5903.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Food.
4231-4979-5856-5903.description:
Activate a Food using Gilded Goose's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate two of the artifact tokens using Gilded Goose's second ability by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1126-3047-5195.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Feign Death.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Feign Death.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2921-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
2921-5972-5973.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

3129-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3129-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1525-1636-3585-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1525-1636-3585-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Greensleeves triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the first Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
When the Badger enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 for any remaining trigger(s), if needed.
Repeat from step 1.

1645-1765-3129-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1183-1988-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Pentavus.
You control at least one additional creature.
1183-1988-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1185-1818-2308-2745-3099.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1185-1818-2308-2745-3099.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {1}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Angel of Vitality.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

3487-3921-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3487-3921-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

104-360-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
You have a way to gain life.
104-360-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden, causing you to gain five life.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2493-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
The token copy of Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

240-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Atla.
Atla does not have summoning sickness.
240-2034-2178.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Egg creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Egg, adding {C}{C}.
The Egg dies, triggering Atla twice.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the second Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
